tbesh_html:
1) to rise up, grow up, be exalted in triumph
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to rise up
1a2) to grow up
1a3) to be lifted up, be raised up, be exalted

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to mount up; hence, in general, to rise, (figuratively) be majestic
strongs_1890.kjv_def: gloriously, grow up, increase, be risen, triumph.
